# sample-project

A fixture project. It exists so `core` has a complete, valid llmwiki to parse
in tests; it is not a real project and nothing here is built.

## Project memory (llmwiki)

- Journal: local_context/notes/
- Kind: software
- Schema + workflows: `/llmwiki` skill.
- **Read `local_context/wiki/00_state.md` first in every session.**
